structured_output.what_is_happening: A Beff Jezos (@beffjezos) X post (status 2103593870189858971, linked on GeckoTerminal; I could not open it, HTTP 402) set off a wave of "Effective Accelerationism" / e/acc tokens. At least 9 same-name clones were deployed within about 25 minutes. This one was created directly on PumpSwap (no pump.fun curve, deploy platform unknown) at 21:24 UTC. It is about 20 minutes old, has a market cap near $28k and is up about 160% in its first hour. The volume looks manufactured: GeckoTerminal shows 2,056 unique buyers against only 52 unique sellers, and GMGN tags 38 bundler wallets holding about 23.6% of top-trader share. The clone the market actually prefers is CbcyNo...(a $324k market cap and $2.08M of volume in the last hour), which is about 9 minutes older than this one.

narrative.description: A Beff Jezos / e/acc post: a well-known tech/AI-accelerationist figure whose post set off a burst of same-name launches. I could not verify what the post says.
narrative.why_spreading: A post from a famous account set off a race of clones. Attention is split across about 10 same-name tokens.

token_connection.why_this_token: Only the name and ticker link it. It is not the first e/acc token and not the leader. It has no socials, no DexScreener profile, and its only link is Beff's X status.
token_connection.competing_tokens: CbcyNo7m... ($324k mcap, $2.08M h1 volume, created earlier) is the clear leader. EsVbL6 ($670k h1 volume), EnmeFDQ ($891k h1 volume), 6TrwU9 ($128k mcap) and DseCuJ ($124k mcap) are also live, plus an older 2024 GqmEdR e/acc token.

authenticity.evidence: GeckoTerminal counts 2,056 unique buyers but only 52 unique sellers, and 1,372 of those buyers arrived within 15 minutes. That pattern fits a multi-wallet bot or bundle distribution. GMGN tags 38 bundler wallets (23.6% top bundler trader share). The pool was deployed directly on PumpSwap, the creator's token status is 'creator_close', and there are no socials. My contract-address search found nothing.
authenticity.uncertainty: Real buyers may be rotating in from the Beff post hype, and GeckoTerminal's unique-seller count may undercount.

structural_risks: The pool holds 62% of supply, with DexScreener liquidity of about $35k, roughly the size of the market cap. The LP is not burned (lp_burn_ratio 0) and not locked.
The deploy is direct on PumpSwap, not a pump.fun curve, so the creator's LP can be pulled.
It is one of about 10 clones with attention split between them, and its h1 volume is roughly a quarter of the leader's.

structured_output.counterargument: Beff Jezos is a big name, the rush is fresh (under 30 minutes old), and this coin still has strong buy pressure (+27% in 5 minutes, 486 buys vs 303 sells). Its $28k market cap is low, so money rotating out of the $324k leader into cheaper clones could push it past 2x quickly. Its creator's best earlier token reached a $452k ATH.

Whether the creator holds the LP and can pull it

How attention is rotating among the clones

source_coverage.notes: The X status fetch returned HTTP 402. A web search for the contract address found nothing. Searching Beff/e/acc token news found only the older BeffAI token and podcasts. The token has no website or socials. Reddit, Telegram and Discord were not attempted because of the time limit.

structured_output.thesis: This is a non-canonical clone in a crowded same-name race triggered by a Beff Jezos post. The volume looks bot or bundle driven, and the LP is not locked on a direct PumpSwap deploy. It has momentum, but the leader token captures most of the attention. Rug and fade risk is high, and there is a small tail chance of a rotation pump.
